subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite this stale branch on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it after another PR owns the Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The branch is conflicting across current protocol, UI, and restart lifecycle boundaries, so the remaining path is an ownership and merge-safety choice rather than a narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update this branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Close after canonical replacement
options.body: If a newer viable PR owns the linked Dashboard recovery issue, this stale branch can close as superseded.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current filtered active-run helpers and restart-only shutdown semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main protocol, Control UI, and active-run lifecycle work points to steipete as the best available routing owner for the rebase or replacement decision.
